question: 统计不同生产线的平均缺陷率，并按缺陷率从高到低排序
sql: SELECT l.line_id AS production_line, AVG(f.defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate FROM fact_production_record f LEFT JOIN dim_line l ON f.production_line = l.line_id GROUP BY l.line_id ORDER BY avg_defect_rate DESC
description: 按生产线聚合平均缺陷率

question: 统计各产品的平均良率
sql: SELECT f.product_type, AVG(f.first_pass_yield) AS avg_yield FROM fact_production_record f GROUP BY f.product_type ORDER BY avg_yield DESC
description: 按产品类型聚合平均良率

question: 查询停机时长最长的设备
sql: SELECT f.machine_id, SUM(f.downtime_minutes) AS total_downtime FROM fact_production_record f GROUP BY f.machine_id ORDER BY total_downtime DESC LIMIT 10
description: 按设备汇总停机时长并排序

question: 统计不同班次的平均质量得分
sql: SELECT f.shift, AVG(f.quality_score) AS avg_quality_score FROM fact_production_record f GROUP BY f.shift ORDER BY avg_quality_score DESC
description: 按班次聚合平均质量得分

question: 统计各生产线的总产量
sql: SELECT f.production_line, SUM(f.production_volume) AS total_volume FROM fact_production_record f GROUP BY f.production_line ORDER BY total_volume DESC

question: 找出故障次数最多的设备
sql: SELECT f.machine_id, SUM(f.fault_event_count) AS total_faults FROM fact_production_record f GROUP BY f.machine_id ORDER BY total_faults DESC LIMIT 10

question: 按产品类型统计平均缺陷率和平均良率
sql: SELECT f.product_type, AVG(f.defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate, AVG(f.first_pass_yield) AS avg_yield FROM fact_production_record f GROUP BY f.product_type ORDER BY avg_defect_rate DESC
description: 按产品类型同时统计缺陷率和良率

question: 统计每条生产线关联的设备数量
sql: SELECT l.line_id, COUNT(m.machine_id) AS machine_count FROM dim_line l LEFT JOIN dim_machine m ON l.line_id = m.line_id GROUP BY l.line_id ORDER BY machine_count DESC
description: 统计生产线下的设备数量
